It is anticipated that the pool of eligible applicants will be expanded as testing progresses.","publishedAt":"2026-11-16","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-23304","title":"Safety Zone; Huron River, Huron, OH","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/16/2026-23304/safety-zone-huron-river-huron-oh","summary":"The Coast Guard is establishing a temporary safety zone for navigable waters of the Huron River within a 150-yard radius of 41[deg]23'34.6\" N, 82[deg]33'07.7\" W in Huron, OH. The safety zone is needed to protect personnel, vessels, and the marine environment from potential hazards created by an over water fireworks show. These actions were taken in accordance with the Monetary Control Act of 1980 (MCA), which requires that, over the long run, fees for Federal Reserve priced services be established based on all direct and indirect costs, including the PSAF. Copies of all fee schedules are available from the Federal Reserve Financial Services (FRFS) website at www.FRBservices.org.","publishedAt":"2026-11-16","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-23288","title":"Accuracy of Advertising and Notice of Insured Status","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/16/2026-23288/accuracy-of-advertising-and-notice-of-insured-status","summary":"The NCUA Board (Board) is issuing this final rule to streamline its regulations governing advertising and the notice of insured status. This final rule eliminates provisions concerning the official advertising statement. This action is undertaken to reduce regulatory complexity, and the intended effect is to reduce the administrative burden and costs for federally insured credit unions (FICUs) and provide them with greater flexibility in their advertising activities. The final rule does not amend requirements related to displaying the official sign.","publishedAt":"2026-11-16","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-23286","title":"Privacy of Consumer Financial Information","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/16/2026-23286/privacy-of-consumer-financial-information","summary":"The NCUA Board (Board) is issuing a final rule to make technical corrections to provisions of the NCUA's regulations.
